prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Desktop Controls", "Try out pet commands right now so you know how to summon or hide your pet at any time.", "Press Alt+P to toggle visibility, or right-click your pet to open quick actions.", "Finish Onboarding"]
1: ["Calibrating desktop soundscape and ambient audio sync...", "Audio Environment Setup: 60%"]
2: ["How Your Desktop Pet Operates", "Your pet wanders your screen freely and responds whenever you click or drag.", "Next: Docking & Hiding", "Hiding & Docking Controls", "Send your pet to the system tray whenever you need full screen space for focus.", "Complete Onboarding"]
3: ["Completing adoption unlocks a free starter toy bundle for your new companion!", "Free Starter Item Bundle Included"]
4: ["Quick setup takes under 2 minutes. Pick your path to begin."]
5: ["Signing in secures your pet traits, items, and adoption progress in the cloud."]
6: ["Verify Photo Clarity", "Confirm your photo has good lighting and a clear subject for optimal rendering.", "Bright lighting, centered face, sharp focus", "Confirm and Generate"]
7: ["Preparing 3D pet graphics and desktop overlay renderer...", "Graphics Engine Warmup: 80%"]
8: ["System Tray Controls", "Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to adjust settings or summon your pet anytime.", "Got It"]
9: ["Tip: Well-lit photos with clear contrast produce the best custom pet colors."]
